ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - VFE Medieval 2 Pack
ModMetaData.author: Peren.
ModMetaData.description:
3D models for the buildings of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Medieval 2 in IsoRim Waylith's 3D view. Beds, hearths, workbenches and their tool stands, barrels, wall turrets, castle doors and castle gates, and the Viking style furniture. Also armour, clothes, hats, the torch belt and held shields (with an IsoRim Waylith that has apparel models, Api 9). Load after IsoRim Waylith and VFE Medieval 2.
为 IsoRim Waylith 的 3D 视角加入「原版派系扩展 - 中世纪 2」建筑的 3D 模型。 包括床、壁炉、工作台及其配件、酒桶、墙挂炮塔、城堡门、城堡大门，以及维京风格家具。 还有盔甲、衣服、头饰、火把腰带和手持盾牌（需要支持服装模型的 IsoRim Waylith，Api 9）。 请放在 IsoRim Waylith 和中世纪 2 之后加载。
